svg.text: Six single rooms along an open corridor, a five-minute
walk from UM Tagum. Rent covers water; electricity is
metered per room. Curfew 10 PM, no overnight guests.
Quiet at night and the landlady lives next door.
Water pressure drops in the afternoon though.
Fifteen minutes to campus on foot, less by jeep.
Room is small but the rent has not changed.
